payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various post-processing approaches applied to the output of translations, including rescoring, unknown word replacement, and restoring special tokens.

claims.text: Post-processing includes language model rescoring to select fluent translation candidates.
Unknown word replacement (UWR) is used to reduce the impact of out-of-vocabulary words in translations.
Restoration of special tokens like <NUMBER> and <DATE> to their original values in the translated sentences is performed.
An ensemble method is applied by selecting the top translations and rescoring them to choose the best one.
